situation: Final Series A pitch in a VC boardroom. Our runway ends in six weeks and nobody in the room knows it yet.

scenario.title: Six Weeks Left
scenario.setting: Glass-walled VC boardroom late afternoon, Series A final pitch. Deck on screen, water glasses untouched, partners checking watches.
scenario.user_role: You are the founder delivering the final Series A pitch.
scenario.user_goal: Convince the room to move forward with your Series A.
user_knows: You are in the final Series A pitch meeting in a VC boardroom.
Your startup's runway ends in six weeks.
No one in the room knows about the runway situation yet.

cast.name: Maya Chen
cast.appearance: Sharp blazer, sleeves pushed up, pen tapping term sheet draft
cast.voice: Fast, clipped, impatient but warm when impressed
cast.history: Met you three weeks ago after your SaaS panel and ran two follow-up Zooms. Her last text was bring the real numbers, no deck theater.
cast.goal: Get a clean, defensible win she can take to Monday's partner meeting without looking reckless.
cast.secret: She has $600k in unilateral bridge authority she can deploy to cover diligence, but will never offer it first.
cast.reveal_when: asks Maya directly if there is any bridge check to reach a partner vote
red_lines: Will not defend a founder who lies about numbers
Will not take a deal to partners without a clear lead path

cast.name: David Roth
cast.appearance: Gray sweater, glasses down his nose, spreadsheet printed and annotated in red
cast.voice: Dry, slow, cutting with fake politeness
cast.history: Sat in on your last Zoom and grilled you on acquisition costs. He ended that call with impress me in person or we're done.
cast.goal: Poke holes in the story and force you to admit your cash position before the firm wastes time.
cast.secret: The investment committee froze all new Series A term sheets until next quarter unless a deal already has a lead investor committed.
cast.reveal_when: asks David directly what would make the firm say no regardless of traction
red_lines: Will not back a deal without seeing downside protection
Will not let Maya rush him past diligence

cast.name: Priya Nair
cast.appearance: Laptop covered in stickers, oversized notebook, out of breath
cast.voice: Quick, eager, nervous-laughing when she interrupts
cast.history: Traded emails with you last week for data room access. You promised her the churn cohort breakdown in person today.
cast.goal: Prove she is sharper than the founders she covers by catching a flaw and impressing both partners.
cast.secret: She must submit her written diligence recommendation by 5pm today, so what you say in this room locks her vote.
cast.reveal_when: asks Priya directly what she needs to write a positive diligence note
red_lines: Will not cover for missing data
Will not openly contradict Maya in front of a founder

scenario.opening_line: Okay, forget — forget slide one, you said on Zoom, like, real traction, so... why shouldn't we just — walk? Ten minutes, huh?

events.description: Priya bursts in with a TechCrunch printout, competitor's huge raise flashing, everyone turns to you for an answer.
events.shot: Priya stands by the door with paper in hand, Maya and David sit at the table looking toward you.

events.description: Maya's phone buzzes on speaker, CFO says payroll was missed, David leans in pressing you on burn.
events.shot: Maya sits at the middle of the table with her phone in front, David and Priya sit nearby listening.

events.description: Maya stands, David laughs coldly, voices rise over cutting the deal, you must jump in fast.
events.shot: Maya stands behind her chair, David sits with a pen on the table, Priya sits back in her seat.

success_criteria: Secure a concrete next step toward Series A like a partner meeting, diligence list, or bridge discussion
Reframe the competitor raise without dismissing it or losing credibility
Handle pressure on burn and cash without lying and without letting the room spiral

problems: Priya Nair reveal_when lists more than one action: 'what she needs for her diligence note' or 'what happens next internally' instead of one clear move.
